On the Border Menu: Must-Try Dishes You Can’t Miss

When it comes to enjoying authentic Mexican cuisine, On the Border Mexican Grill stands out as a go-to destination for food lovers. With its lively cantina atmosphere and a menu brimming with flavorful dishes, it offers something for everyone. This guide dives deep into the On the Border menu, highlighting must-try dishes and the best deals available, ensuring that your dining experience is nothing short of delightful.

What Makes On the Border Unique?

The Atmosphere of the Border Mexican Grill

Stepping into an On the Border location is like taking a mini-vacation to Mexico. The vibrant decor, upbeat music, and friendly service create an inviting environment perfect for any occasion. Whether you’re planning a family dinner, a night out with friends, or a casual lunch, the lively atmosphere at this Mexican restaurant is sure to enhance your dining experience.

Quality Ingredients and Authentic Flavors

On the Border prides itself on using fresh, quality ingredients in every dish. From their signature salsas to the marinated meats grilled to perfection, each meal is crafted with care. The emphasis on authentic Mexican food ensures that every bite transports you to the heart of Mexico.

Exploring the On the Border Menu

The On the Border menu is extensive, featuring a variety of categories, including appetizers, salads, tacos, enchiladas, fajitas, burritos, and desserts. Below, we’ll explore some must-try dishes, along with pricing tables and descriptions to help you make the best choices.

Appetizers: Starting Strong

Appetizers are the perfect way to kick off your meal, and On the Border offers a range of delicious options. Here are some standout appetizers along with their prices:

Appetizer Description Price
Signature Queso A blend of melted cheeses and green chilies, perfect for dipping. $8.99
Guacamole Freshly made with whole avocados, lime, and spices. $7.99
Border Nachos Crispy corn tortillas topped with cheese, jalapeños, and your choice of meat. $10.99
Fajita Nachos Loaded with mesquite-grilled steak or chicken, served with guacamole and sour cream. $12.99
Crispy Chicken Flautas Rolled corn tortillas filled with chicken, served with guacamole and salsa. $9.99

Salads: Fresh and Flavorful

For those seeking lighter fare, On the Border offers an array of salads that are both satisfying and delicious:

Salad Description Price
Mexican Caesar Salad Crisp romaine lettuce topped with grilled chicken, parmesan, and caesar dressing. $10.99
Fajita Chicken Salad Grilled chicken served on a bed of greens with pico de gallo and guacamole. $12.99
Taco Salad A crispy tortilla bowl filled with lettuce, black beans, and your choice of meat. $11.99

Tacos: A Mexican Staple

Tacos are a beloved staple in Mexican cuisine, and On the Border has some of the best options around:

Tacos Description Price
Chicken Tacos Soft or crispy tortillas filled with marinated chicken, topped with fresh ingredients. $9.99
Steak Tacos Mesquite-grilled steak topped with cilantro and onions, served on soft corn tortillas. $10.99
Shrimp Tacos Lightly grilled shrimp with a zesty lime sauce, served with cabbage and salsa. $11.99

Enchiladas: Flavorful and Filling

Enchiladas are a highlight of the On the Border menu, showcasing authentic flavors wrapped in corn tortillas:

Enchiladas Description Price
Cheese Enchiladas Cheese-filled corn tortillas topped with enchilada sauce and melted cheese. $9.99
Chicken Enchiladas Shredded chicken wrapped in tortillas, smothered in ranchero sauce. $10.99
Beef Enchiladas Ground beef-filled tortillas topped with a rich chili sauce. $10.99

Fajitas: Sizzle and Flavor

The fajitas at On the Border are a highlight for many diners, known for their fresh ingredients and bold flavors:

Fajitas Description Price
Chicken Fajitas Marinated grilled chicken served with sautéed peppers and onions, tortillas, and sides. $13.99
Steak Fajitas Mesquite-grilled steak served with all the traditional fixings. $14.99
Combo Fajitas A mix of chicken and steak, perfect for sharing. $15.99

Burritos: A Complete Meal

Burritos are perfect for those looking for a filling meal. On the Border offers delicious options that won’t disappoint:

Burritos Description Price
Bean Burrito Refried beans rolled in a flour tortilla, topped with cheese and sauce. $9.99
Chicken Burrito Grilled chicken, rice, and cheese wrapped in a flour tortilla, smothered in sauce. $10.99
Steak Burrito Filled with mesquite-grilled steak and sautéed onions. $11.99

Special Border-Style Dishes

The On the Border menu also features unique border-style dishes that embody authentic flavors:

Special Dishes Description Price
Border-Style Chicken Grilled chicken topped with chile sauce, served with rice and beans. $12.99
Carnitas Plate Slow-roasted pork served with tortillas and guacamole. $13.99

Desserts: Sweet Finishes

Don’t forget to save room for dessert! On the Border offers delightful options to round off your meal:

Desserts Description Price
Sopapillas Fried pastries topped with honey and cinnamon. $5.99
Churros Crispy dough sticks coated in sugar and served with chocolate sauce. $6.99

Ordering Options

One of the best features of On the Border is the flexibility it offers when it comes to ordering.

Order Online for Convenience

You can easily order online through the On the Border website or mobile app. This allows you to browse the entire menu, customize your order, and avoid waiting in line.

Track Your Order for Peace of Mind

Once you’ve placed your order, you can track your order through the app or website. This feature ensures you’re informed about when your meal will be ready for pickup or delivery.

Takeout and Delivery Options

On the Border provides excellent takeout options, allowing you to enjoy your favorite meals in the comfort of your home. If you prefer delivery, be mindful of any delivery fees that may apply based on your location.

Summary of Menu Pricing

Category Average Price Range

Salads $10.99 – $12.99

Enchiladas $9.99 – $10.99
Fajitas $13.99 – $15.99
Burritos $9.99 – $11.99
Special Border-Style Dishes $12.99 – $13.99
Desserts $5.99 – $6.99

Conclusion

On the Border Mexican Grill is a fantastic destination for anyone craving authentic Mexican food. With an extensive menu featuring mouthwatering appetizers, salads, tacos, enchiladas, fajitas, burritos, and desserts, there’s something for every palate. The lively atmosphere, quality ingredients, and commitment to flavor make it a must-visit spot.

By utilizing the convenient order online option, tracking your order, and taking advantage of their takeout and delivery services, you can enjoy a delicious meal from the comfort of your home. So whether you’re dining in or taking out, make sure to explore the On the Border menu for must-try dishes you won’t want to miss. Enjoy your culinary adventure at On the Border!
